issues.description: url field uses a YAML list (array) with two entries instead of a single string. The code_style rule example (section 13) shows url as a scalar string. While Conan 2.x supports list URLs for mirror fallback and both URLs are HTTPS/quoted, this differs from the documented style guide pattern.
issues.fix_suggestion: If mirror fallback is needed for non-GitHub sources, consider keeping the list but add a comment explaining the rationale. Alternatively, use a single official URL and rely on Conan/CI mirror mechanisms.

issues.description: build_date is '2026-06-02' in manifest.yaml but notes.md records '编译日期: 2026-06-03'. A one-day discrepancy between metadata and build notes.
issues.fix_suggestion: Align build_date in manifest.yaml with the actual build completion date recorded in notes.md (2026-06-03).

issues.description: configure_options lists '--prefix=$DEFAULT_PREFIX' but conanfile.py generate() only appends '--with-included-gettext'. The --prefix is handled internally by Conan's AutotoolsToolchain (not an explicit configure arg in the recipe). Documenting it as a configure_option creates a minor mismatch between manifest metadata and actual recipe behavior.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either add a comment in manifest.yaml noting that prefix is managed by Conan toolchain, or remove --prefix from configure_options since it is not explicitly set in the recipe.

issues.description: Patch format inconsistency: patches 0001-0006 use 'diff -ruN a/file b/file' header format (GNU diff with -ruN flags), while patches 0007-0008 use standard unified diff format ('--- a/file' / '+++ b/file' without the diff header line). Both formats are valid and applyable, but they are inconsistent within the same package.
issues.fix_suggestion: Use a consistent patch format across all 8 patch files. If using refresh-patch --auto (R3), verify that all patches are regenerated with the same tool to ensure format uniformity.

issues.description: _generate_plural_h() runs 'bison -d' which generates both plural.c and plural.h. If triggered (plural.h missing AND bison available), bison would regenerate plural.c, potentially overwriting patch 0005's changes to plural.c (yyparse signature and yylex call). The method only fixes the header (plural.h) afterward, not the .c file. This is an edge case: release tarballs typically include pre-generated plural.h, so bison would not be invoked. The code also has try/except fallbacks.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding a guard to skip bison execution if plural.c has already been patched (e.g., check if 'void *arg' is already present in plural.c), or use 'bison --defines=plural.h -o /dev/null' to only generate the header without overwriting plural.c.

issues.description: Notes.md '依赖版本' section records 'libxml2: 2.x' (generic) while conanfile.py and manifest.yaml both specify the exact version 'libxml2/2.15.3.1'. Minor version documentation mismatch.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update notes.md to specify the exact dependency version 'libxml2/2.15.3.1' to match conanfile.py and manifest.yaml.
